CustomField.description: JSON array defining the answer scale for a Likert Matrix section in Number mode (#144): ordered entries of {"label", "value", "help"} where label renders as the column header, value is the number stored into the row's field when that column is selected, and help (optional) surfaces as a tooltip on the header. Edited through the builder's scale editor modal; ignored in Picklist mode (columns come from the first field's option set there). Carried to Form_Section__mdt via config__c JSON.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Defines your Number-mode answer scale as ordered columns of label, stored number, and optional help text. Edit it with the scale editor in Form Builder rather than by hand; in Picklist mode this is ignored because the columns come from your picklist's options.
CustomField.label: Likert Scale
